name: minimal_required_fields_only
description: Only the three required fields. All optional fields absent.

name: full_canonical_fields
description: All nine canonical hash fields populated. Identical hash under v1 and v2 because no null-vs-empty-string ambiguity exists.

input.description: Install the 480V transformer pad before the site walkthrough

name: empty_optional_strings_distinct_from_missing_v2
description: owner_company and owed_to_company passed as empty strings. Under v2 these are PRESERVED as "" in the canonical form, distinct from the null produced when those fields are absent. Under v1 they would have collapsed to the same hash as 'minimal_required_fields_only'. This fixture exists to catch any regression that re-introduces the v1 null/empty-string conflation.

name: explicit_nulls_equal_missing
description: Optional fields explicitly null - must hash identically to 'minimal_required_fields_only' under both v1 and v2 (null and 'absent' are equivalent in both versions).

name: unicode_description
description: Description contains non-ASCII characters (French, Japanese, emoji-free). Verifies UTF-8 handling parity between Node and Python.

name: extra_fields_filtered_out
description: Input has fields beyond the 9 canonical hash fields (confidence, context, source_reference, plus spurious extras). They must NOT affect the hash - must hash identically to 'full_canonical_fields'.

name: insertion_order_does_not_matter
description: Same content as 'full_canonical_fields' but keys are inserted in a scrambled order. Must hash identically because canonicalization sorts alphabetically.

name: confidence_field_does_not_affect_hash_string

name: v1_legacy_minimal_required_fields_only
description: Same input as 'minimal_required_fields_only' but hashed under v1 rules. v1 collapsed missing string fields to "" instead of null, so the v1 hash differs from the v2 hash for the same input. Pinned to catch regressions in the v1 fallback path that verifyCommitment uses for pre-2026-04-26 commitments.

name: v1_legacy_empty_optional_strings_equal_missing
description: Under v1, owner_company="" and owed_to_company="" hash IDENTICALLY to the missing case (because v1 collapsed both to ""). Pinned alongside 'v1_legacy_minimal_required_fields_only' so both v1 fixtures must produce the same hash - this is the v1 invariant v2 deliberately broke.
